mode: Built-in image generation; PNG exports resized to 128x128 for Discord

prompts.cross: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target: HUSS cross award banner. Convert its central award emblem into ONE square Discord emoji. Remove all leather background, rectangular border and wide banner scenery. Preserve the distinctive central symbol and gold/crimson identity; simplify tiny engraving for readability at 32px. Keep the complete emblem, compact, centered, filling 90% of a square canvas with minimal transparent padding. Crisp strong silhouette and clean alpha edges. True transparent background, no shadow outside the emblem. Antique gold, crimson red, charcoal and warm ivory only, NO blue. No text. Output a square transparent PNG icon.
